name: Dialogus
long_description:
Dialogus builds self-improving AI voice agents for enterprise operations.

Our agents handle high-volume workflows across customer support, sales, collections, and other operational functions, integrating directly with the systems enterprises already use.

Our agents continuously learn from real conversations and business outcomes: identifying where interactions fail, proposing improvements, testing those changes across thousands of simulated conversations, and deploying better versions with human oversight.

The result is AI that doesn’t just automate calls, it gets better at doing the job over time.

launches.title: Dialogus: Building the infra for enterprise voice agents
launches.body:
Every year, enterprises spend billions of dollars operating contact centers. They struggle with high labor costs, long wait times, inconsistent customer experiences, and the challenge of hiring and retaining thousands of agents.

Most AI voice products try to automate individual phone calls. We believe the real opportunity is much bigger: rebuilding the contact center itself.

Dialogus replaces traditional contact center operations with AI voice agents that can answer calls, resolve customer requests end-to-end, integrate with enterprise systems, and scale across hundreds of locations while maintaining a consistent customer experience.

Today, Dialogus is already powering AI voice operations for Fortune 500 enterprises, handling thousands of customer calls in production.

The company was founded by Rodrigo Teran, Hans Ibarra, and Juberth Rodriguez after seeing how legacy contact center software wasn't built for the AI era. Instead of layering AI on top of decades-old infrastructure, they're building an AI-native contact center from the ground up.

If you're an enterprise looking to transform your customer support with AI, we'd love to talk.
